evidence.statement: 普里什蒂纳的街道优先服务汽车，儿童（尤其是较大儿童）的公共空间需求常被忽视；适合主动游戏、社交与探索的空间在城市中很少。
evidence.quote_or_span: Its vibrant cafe-lined streets prioritize cars… the needs of its youngest inhabitants, especially those of older children… are a particularly rare find in the city.
evidence.notes: 项目方叙述；不是独立观察

evidence.statement: 该共创试点由儿童洞见、专业数据探索和 AI 工具共同驱动；CEF 与 Healthier Kosovo 2 两个 UNDP 项目由此联合，市政府公共空间与公园局全程支持。
evidence.quote_or_span: Fueled by children’s insights, professional data exploration, and a touch of artificial intelligence tools… unified the City Experiment Fund (CEF) and the Healthier Kosovo 2 projects… Department of Public Spaces and Parks… steadfast supporter.
evidence.notes: 同时包含情境与主体信息

evidence.statement: 10–17 岁儿童经市政府任命的 Children Councils 从各学校选出，参加由 SpaceSyntaks 与 Save the Children 主持的头脑风暴、设计圆桌和 AI 测试工作坊；参与者按多元背景与视角筛选。
evidence.quote_or_span: Children aged 10-17, each representing their schools through Children Councils appointed by the Municipality… participated in a series of brainstorming sessions, design roundtables and AI testing workshops facilitated by SpaceSyntaks and Save the Children.
evidence.notes: M03 使用 11–17 岁与 Assembly of Children 的表述

evidence.statement: 项目把儿童视为贯穿所有共创阶段的平等参与者，使其以“自己空间的专家”身份表达。
evidence.quote_or_span: involve children as equal participants throughout all stages of co-design… experts of their own spaces.
evidence.notes: 规范性表述，非实施记录

evidence.statement: 儿童一致认为缺少儿童友好公共空间；女童对社交时的安全与隐私有显著担忧，这一洞见来自头脑风暴。
evidence.quote_or_span: The one thing that all the children came to agree on was the lack of child-friendly public spaces… a notable concern among girl children regarding safety and the need for more privacy while socializing.
evidence.notes: 项目方对儿童共识的转述

evidence.statement: 14 岁参与者 Anila Ajeti 称学校附近没有适合与朋友社交或做小组作业的公共空间，现有空间要么给幼儿、要么给成人，她们常只能去他人家中。
evidence.quote_or_span: There is not a single suitable public space near my school… The current spaces available are either for little children or adults. Instead, we always end up going to somebody’s house…
evidence.notes: 由项目方选择、翻译和编辑的引语；学校位置不等于干预地点

evidence.statement: 13 岁参与者 Enea Kadriu 称自然环境能提升学习动力与效率，开放绿地有助于社交并减少屏幕时间。
evidence.quote_or_span: Learning in an open environment motivates me and increases my productivity… it would help me socialize and reduce screen time.
evidence.context: 参与者引语，Xhavit Ahmeti 学校，Kolovica/Kojlovica
evidence.notes: 由项目方选择、翻译和编辑的引语

evidence.statement: 工作坊被设计为帮助儿童识别合适地点、形成愿景、理解方案的环境影响、做出有依据的设计选择，并理解包容性空间对不同能力与兴趣者的意义。
evidence.quote_or_span: identify the most suitable locations, frame their visions, understand the environmental impact of their proposals, make informed design choices… inclusive spaces…
evidence.notes: 描述设计意图，不是每次工作坊的实际内容

evidence.statement: 选址后，儿童参与公共空间愿景、汇报与反馈；随后用 mood board、AI 平台与互动共创工具把愿景转成具体设计，并与儿童中心设计与城市规划专业人士合作；故事称 AI 把儿童愿景“增强”为可感设计，并考虑安全、环境与社会包容。
evidence.quote_or_span: Following site selection… visioning, presentations, and feedback sessions… mood boards, aided by the integration of an AI platform and an interactive co-design tool… augmenting their visions into tangible designs…
evidence.notes: 项目方未点名 UrbanistAI；“AI 增强”为项目方评价

evidence.statement: 最终评估工作坊上，儿童评估专业设计师根据 6 个月共创输入制作的方案；最终在普里什蒂纳三个不同地点形成三份儿童友好公共空间方案。
evidence.quote_or_span: During the Final Evaluation Workshop children had the opportunity to assess and evaluate the design proposals created by professional designers… three proposals for child friendly public spaces in three different locations… got finalized.
evidence.notes: 未给最终评估工作坊日期；按文章日期 2023-09-14 在此之前

evidence.statement: UNDP Kosovo 已启动其中两份最终方案的实施；故事称两个创新的儿童友好空间将进入城市肌理。
evidence.quote_or_span: The UNDP office in Kosovo has initiated the implementation of two of the finalized designs… two innovative child-friendly spaces will be woven into the urban fabric…
evidence.notes: initiated 不等于建成；与 M03 的许可/更新表述需分层

evidence.statement: Design 1 强调亲密尺度，包含圆形座椅（游戏/聚会）、秋千（游戏互动）和带桌座椅（小组学习/社交）。
evidence.quote_or_span: circular seating arrangement for games and gatherings, swings for playful interactions, and seating with tables for smaller group learning or socializing sessions.
evidence.notes: 未给 Design 1 的具体地点

evidence.statement: Design 2 是普里什蒂纳中心的一处开放绿地，用于露天剧场、电影放映、协作音乐等文化活动；靠近学校与本地公交站，配置兼顾美学、可持续、安全与环保材料。
evidence.quote_or_span: open green space at the heart of Pristina… open-air theatre, cinema screenings, and collaborative music creation. Situated near schools and a local bus station… Safety measures and eco-friendly materials…
evidence.notes: 未给 Design 2 的具体地名

evidence.statement: CEF 由 UNDP Kosovo 与斯洛伐克财政部设立，聚焦实验性城市项目；其中一个项目与普里什蒂纳市政府合作，回应儿童友好空间稀缺，结合儿童参与、行为洞见/数据与 AI，并以健康与福祉为焦点。
evidence.quote_or_span: the CEF, established by UNDP Kosovo and the Slovak Ministry of Finance… One such project, in collaboration with the Municipality… addresses the scarcity of child-friendly spaces… leveraging innovative tech like AI… health and well-being focus.
evidence.notes: 与 M13 的 CEF 机制描述可互证，但 M01 为项目方叙述

evidence.statement: Healthier Kosovo 2 由 UNDP、WHO、UNV 共同实施、卢森堡大公国政府资助，目标是减少环境相关问题、提升 CSO 意识并通过创新方案影响政策。
evidence.quote_or_span: a joint initiative implemented by the UNDP, WHO, and UNV, and funded by the Government of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg…
evidence.notes: 与 M12 可互证

evidence.statement: M02 复述 M01 的核心口径：10–17 岁儿童经 Children Councils 参与、由 SpaceSyntaks 与 Save the Children 主持工作坊、最终形成三份方案并启动两份实施。
evidence.quote_or_span: Children aged 10-17, each representing their schools through Children Councils appointed by the Municipality… participated in a series of brainstorming sessions, design roundtables and AI testing workshops facilitated by SpaceSyntaks and Save the Children… three proposals… got finalized… initiated the implementation of two of the finalized designs…
evidence.notes: 与 M01 措辞高度一致，不构成独立来源

evidence.statement: 评估报告称：在 5 场利益相关方工作坊之外，另有 4 场儿童工作坊，超过 50 名 11–17 岁儿童参加，使用 Urbanist AI 工具进行协作设计。
evidence.quote_or_span: four additional workshops engaged over 50 children… for ages 11 to 17. These workshops utilised an Urbanist AI tool, facilitating collaborative design processes.
evidence.context: HK2 指标 1.3.d 评估分析
evidence.notes: 50+ 是否去重未知；4 场儿童工作坊的日期与场次未给

evidence.statement: 评估报告称：市政许可已取得，用于在 3 个地点实施 2 个批准设计；空间使用回收材料与绿化，地点包括主邮局附近、城市公园和 Taukbahce 公园。
evidence.quote_or_span: Municipal permits were secured to implement two approved designs in three locations… near the main postal office, City Park, and the Park of Taukbahce.
evidence.notes: 未说明许可编号、日期与 2 个设计如何对应 3 个地点

evidence.statement: 评估报告把“1 个公园因 Parks Foundation 平台完成更新”设为指标 1.3.d 的目标，并评级为 Fully achieved；报告未说明具体是哪一处公园，也未说明是否属于两份批准设计。
evidence.quote_or_span: 1 park was revitalised as a result of the Parks Foundation platform; Rating: Fully achieved
evidence.notes: 不能据此认定三个地点全部建成

evidence.quote_or_span: August 01, 2021… December 31, 2023; 970,000 EUR; Ilir Hoxha; October 20, 2023 December 15, 2023
evidence.notes: PDF 文本有“December 3115”OCR 错误；以“Period under evaluation”行为准

evidence.statement: 评估采用文件审查与 23 次性别平衡的关键知情人访谈；原计划的焦点小组讨论被重新考虑，未按原计划开展。
evidence.quote_or_span: a gender-balanced set of 23 interviews was conducted… planned focus group discussions were reconsidered
evidence.notes: 说明缺少儿童焦点小组，儿童声音主要经项目方/评估访谈转述

evidence.statement: 评估者认为，让 11–17 岁儿童参与城市发展项目的决策过程，有助于全面理解目标用户的需求与偏好，并形成社区所有权与赋权感。
evidence.quote_or_span: The critical lesson… engaging the target audience, specifically children aged 11 to 17, in the decision-making process… fosters a sense of community ownership and empowerment.
evidence.notes: 评估者判断，不是因果检验

evidence.statement: UNDP Kosovo 发布 RFQ UNDP-KOS-00094“Development of Child-Friendly Public Spaces in Pristina”，2023-09-27 发布，2023-10-24 截止；公告未提供中标或合同信息。
evidence.locator: M04 UNGM notice metadata, extracted L219–232
evidence.quote_or_span: RFQ Development of Child-Friendly Public Spaces in Pristina; Reference: UNDP-KOS-00094; Published on: 27-Sep-2023; Deadline on: 24-Oct-2023
evidence.notes: 只证明采购流程启动

evidence.statement: UTI 是 CEF 的延伸，与市政府为主要伙伴，目标是实施 CEF portfolio co-design 阶段形成的原型，以改善普里什蒂纳城市宜居性。
evidence.quote_or_span: The Urban Transformation Initiative (UTI), an extension of CEF… implementing prototypes developed during the portfolio co-design phase under CEF.
evidence.notes: 页面无发布日期

evidence.statement: UTI 的里程碑包括“为 10 岁以上男女童创造适龄公共户外空间，以改善儿童社交”。
evidence.quote_or_span: Create age-friendly public outdoor spaces for girls and boys aged 10+ to improve children socializing
evidence.notes: 目标/里程碑，不等于已完成

evidence.statement: UTI 页面显示 Status 为 Active (NEW)、Time Frame 为 One Year、预算 270,000 EUR；伙伴包括 UNDP、普里什蒂纳市政府、Healthier Kosovo 2、Climate Promise；资助方为斯洛伐克财政部与普里什蒂纳市政府。
evidence.quote_or_span: Status: Active (NEW); Time Frame: One Year; Budget: 270,000 EUR; Partners: UNDP, Municipality of Pristina, Healthier Kosovo 2, Climate Promise
evidence.notes: 抓取时状态；无日期

evidence.statement: 回顾文章称，普里什蒂纳 10–17 岁儿童在数月内参加头脑风暴、设计圆桌与 AI 测试工作坊；形成两个突出想法：带圆形座椅与秋千的社交枢纽，以及带可持续家具的开放绿地文化场地。
evidence.quote_or_span: Over several months, children aged 10-17 engaged… Two standout ideas emerged: a social hub with circular seating and swings… and an open green space envisioned as a cultural venue with sustainable furniture…
evidence.context: 2025 年区域回顾中的普里什蒂纳段落
evidence.notes: 与 M01 部分重复，无新过程细节

evidence.statement: 回顾文章称这些空间“正从被忽视地区转变为有活力、包容的聚会场所”；该表述为报道性效果陈述，未给出建成日期或验收证据。
evidence.quote_or_span: transforming them from neglected areas into vibrant, inclusive gathering places.
evidence.notes: 不能当作已建成/已使用的事实

evidence.statement: UNDP 与 UrbanistAI 合作，在普里什蒂纳使用 AI 促进公众参与城市规划、空间愿景与决策；博客称其展示了 AI 建设韧性城市、放大市民声音的潜力。
evidence.quote_or_span: UNDP, in partnership with UrbanistAI has utilized AI in the city of Prishtina to foster greater public involvement in urban planning… amplify the voices of citizens…
evidence.context: UNDP Geneva 博客中的科索沃段落
evidence.notes: 机构观点，无项目细节

evidence.statement: 供应商页面称：2023 年，10–17 岁儿童经市政 Children Councils 在 CEF 下参与为期六个月的共创；最终形成三份方案，UNDP 报告其中两份于 2023-09 前启动实施。
evidence.quote_or_span: Children aged 10–17… co-designed… over a six-month process: three proposals were finalised and UNDP reported implementation of two initiated by September 2023.
evidence.notes: 可能转述 M01/M03；不能独立印证

evidence.statement: 供应商页面称：头脑风暴、设计圆桌、AI 测试工作坊与 mood board 把儿童的想法推进为可建方案，包括带模块座椅的圆形剧场和带秋千的游乐/座凳结构。
evidence.quote_or_span: Brainstorming, design roundtables, AI testing workshops and mood boards carried the children’s process from idea to buildable proposal — including an amphitheatre with modular seating and a play-and-seating structure with swings.
evidence.context: 供应商对工具作用的描述
evidence.notes: 设计细节比 M01 更具体，但无图纸/证据

evidence.statement: 供应商页面称 UNDP 启动了两个儿童设计空间的实施，且 UNDP 日内瓦办公室后来把普里什蒂纳合作列为 AI 促进公众参与的例子。
evidence.quote_or_span: UNDP initiated implementation of two child-designed spaces… Geneva office later cited the Prishtina partnership…
evidence.context: 供应商对实施与影响的描述

evidence.statement: 供应商页面说明该项目“以 UrbanistAI 品牌”在其此前的合作中交付；这提供了 CoPlanAI 与 UrbanistAI 的品牌延续线索。
evidence.quote_or_span: We delivered this project under the brand name of UrbanistAI, in our previous collaboration.
evidence.notes: 不证明法律实体或技术版本同一

evidence.statement: 普里什蒂纳于 2022 年加入 CEF，参考此前 Prizren 的经验；平台围绕城市转型开展叙事倾听，并在集体解释空间中进行验证。
evidence.quote_or_span: The city of Prishtina joined the City Experiment Fund in 2022… currently listening to narratives in the city around the topic of urban transformation…
evidence.context: CEF 普里什蒂纳平台背景
evidence.notes: 合作机构叙述；不含儿童空间细节

evidence.statement: Space SyntaKs 称“上周”普里什蒂纳儿童与青少年使用 UrbanistAI 共创儿童友好公共空间；合作方为 UNDP Kosovo、普里什蒂纳市政府与 CEF。
evidence.quote_or_span: Last week, children and teenagers of Prishtina were actively engaged in co-designing child-friendly public spaces using UrbanistAI… collaboration with UNDP Kosovo and the Municipality of Prishtina… City Experiment Fund.

evidence.statement: 帖文称普里什蒂纳多所学校的学生用该平台协作创建安全、环境友好、社会包容的 10+ 儿童空间；儿童生成并可视化想法，工具促进需求表达与协作决策。
evidence.quote_or_span: Pupils from various schools… create safe, environmentally conscious, and socially inclusive spaces for children aged 10 and above… generate and visualize their ideas… facilitated the expression of their needs while enabling collaborative decision-making.
evidence.context: Space SyntaKs 对工作坊的描述
evidence.notes: 工具效果为合作方自述

evidence.statement: 帖文称这些共创地点“很快将呈现新面貌”，属于未来导向表述，未说明完成时间或建成状态。
evidence.quote_or_span: Soon, the locations of Prishtina where children are co-designing will take a new look.
evidence.context: Space SyntaKs 对后续变化的表述
evidence.notes: 计划性表述

evidence.quote_or_span: we held a co-design session using UrbanistAI… a platform that combines Artificial Intelligence with Urban Design… students from various schools in Pristina…

evidence.quote_or_span: the activity was developed as an addendum to the co-design process so far identifying appropriate locations and functions for children aged 10 and older within public and green areas…
evidence.context: UNDP Kosovo 对活动定位的说明
evidence.notes: 证明 2023-06 前已有共创过程，但未给起始日期

evidence.statement: UNDP Kosovo 称“在不久的将来”，这些共创地点将经历转变；属于计划性表述，未给出完成时间。
evidence.quote_or_span: In the near future, Pristina’s locations where children are co-designing will undergo a transformation.
evidence.context: UNDP Kosovo 对后续变化的表述
evidence.notes: 计划性表述
